title.zh: 在联合国教科文组织技术援助下设立社区学校培训中心，设于邦阿西楠省 Bayambang 市镇的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a Training Center for Community Schools with the Technical Assistance of the Unesco to be Located at the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan
title.orig: An Act to Establish a Training Center for Community Schools with the Technical Assistance of the Unesco to be Located at the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1142_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Secretary of Education is hereby authorized to establish and maintain with the technical assistance of the United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization, a training center for community schools to be located at the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1954.
